basic_info.description: A true gem nestled in the most cherished Crocker Amazon district of San Francisco. Meticulously renovated with 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, and 1877 sqft offering the real definition of modern and comfort. Step inside and be greeted by a bright and airy living room providing the ideal setting for both everyday life and entertaining. With warm abundant natural sunlight flowing into the gourmet kitchen showcasing sleek countertops, custom cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances that were meticulously designed with high-end finishes for luxury touches end to end. Featuring four large bedrooms, each offering a relaxing place to unwind for the night. Including the eye-catching master suite with the lavish ensuite bathroom that includes modern fixtures. Low maintenance backyard is perfect for larger families to host family and friends on the weekend. Enjoy the easy convenience and accessibility to shopping, dining, public transportation, schools, and parks. This is a rare opportunity to own a completely renovated beauty in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
